items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: I had everything from of course Charlie Parker, Phil Woods, Ornette Coleman, then Grover Washington Jr., Coltrane

ctx.x: Well it’s funny that you mention that but you know coming from such a small village there was no record store or anything but in the town where my high school was there was a sort of a, you know you could buy anything from eyeglasses to cameras to — it was sort of a multipurpose store and they also had a little music department. And I guess

there was not much interest in jazz LPs at the time of course, so they wanted to get things sold for like a dollar for an LP, they sold off all the jazz LPs. And I just happened to walk into that store at that time. And I bought everything that had a saxophone on it. And I didn’t know, you know I had everything from of course Charlie Parker, Phil Woods, Ornette Coleman, then Grover Washington Jr., Coltrane, but just the most — I listened to — and David Sanborn it was like how can David Sanborn and Phil Woods and…

I just was listening to a few minutes of free jazz this morning sort of revving myself up for this interview — not that that’s what you necessarily do — but it still — I’m not sure how to take it, even at this point.
